description: List recent emails in the workspace, newest first. Use to summarize inbox/sent activity. Returns metadata only (subject, counterparty, timestamp, plus an AI summary and needsReply flag when triage has run), not bodies. Call get_email for a specific message body.

mode.description: inbox = received, sent = outbound, all = both

needs_reply_only.description: Only mail the sender is waiting on a response to. Use for 'what do I still owe replies to?'. Received mail only, and only messages triage has classified.

name: list_recent_emails
